# ============================================================================
# USB shell — the camera's own PTP gadget, repurposed.
#
# The gadget itself is stock: the firmware builds the descriptors, creates and
# enables EP 0x01 OUT / 0x82 IN, and rebuilds them after a record-mode
# reconfig.  That is the whole point — the previous shell bolted on endpoints
# the firmware did not know about, which is why recording tore it down.
#
# Two words are changed; everything else is worker code.
#
#   command set: `shl <line>` only.  The firmware shell's own commands,
#   `mem set` and `mem save` included, are reachable through it.
#
# Boot with the USB cable UNPLUGGED, then attach: the gadget is built on
# attach, so the patches must land first, and the patched words sit in code
# that has not run yet, so no stale I-cache line can shadow them.
#
# Recovery: delete the two `mem set` lines under PATCHES and reboot.
# ============================================================================

# One pulse: AutoRun is running.
display monitor 0 1
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 400
display colorbar 0 0

# --- PATCHES ----------------------------------------------------------------
# mode 5 class handler -> NULL (frees the bulk pipes)
mem set 0xC0031ADC 0xE320F000
# interface class 06/01/01 -> ff/ff/ff (host PTP stack keeps its hands off)
mem set 0xC0CF3740 0xFFFFFF03

# --- worker state @0xC072F000 (16 words) + capture offset ----------------
mem set 0xC072F000 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F004 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F008 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F00C 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F010 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F014 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F018 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F01C 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F020 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F024 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F028 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F02C 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F030 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F034 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F038 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F03C 0x00000000
mem set 0xC072F040 0x00000000

mem set 0xC072E460 0xE12FFF1E

# --- shared 4 KiB DMA frame buffer (address lands in 0xC3757A7C) -------------
memmgr bufmem get 0 0x1000 0x40

# --- start the worker -------------------------------------------------------
# One-shot branch from the gyro callback: cave_entry calls the displaced
# accessor, creates the task, and restores this word.
mem set 0xC00D0794 0xEB197619

# Two pulses: worker armed. A colorbar that never clears means the load failed.
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 400
display colorbar 0 0
ctrl sleep 300
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 400
display colorbar 0 0
ctrl sleep 300

# ======================== DIAGNOSTIC BUILD ==================================
# Attach the USB cable NOW. 45 s from the two pulses above.
ctrl sleep 45000

mem save \PATCH.BIN 0xC0031AD0,,0x20
mem save \IFACE.BIN 0xC0CF373C,,0x10
mem save \PDESC.BIN 0xC3774820,,0x140
mem save \REG.BIN 0xC30792B0,,0x20
mem save \EPTBL.BIN 0xC31E3260,,0x40
mem save \USBST.BIN 0xC31E3740,,0x20
mem save \DALEP.BIN 0x2100C700,,0x40
mem save \VSHL.BIN 0xC072F000,,0x40

# Three short pulses: dumps written. Power off and read the card.
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 250
display colorbar 0 0
ctrl sleep 250
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 250
display colorbar 0 0
ctrl sleep 250
display colorbar 1 0
ctrl sleep 250
display colorbar 0 0
ctrl sleep 250
